formal_role: Defines how real numbers are approximated by finite precision arithmetic
computational_role: Controls rounding behavior tolerance needs and reproducibility
review_warning: Computed precision should not be mistaken for real-world certainty

formal_role: Measures sensitivity of the mathematical problem to input perturbations
computational_role: Determines whether small data changes can strongly alter outputs
review_warning: Ill-conditioned outputs require sensitivity testing and cautious interpretation

formal_role: Quantifies relative sensitivity using a matrix norm and inverse behavior
computational_role: Provides a diagnostic for numerical fragility
review_warning: High condition numbers can make small residuals misleading

formal_role: Measures how well a computed solution satisfies the original equation
computational_role: Checks solver output against the modeled system
review_warning: A small residual alone does not guarantee small forward error

formal_role: Defines the algorithm used to solve factor approximate or iterate
computational_role: Shapes numerical stability runtime and diagnostic behavior
review_warning: Solver choice should match matrix structure conditioning sparsity and accuracy needs

formal_role: Defines row column variable unit or feature transformations
computational_role: Can improve numerical behavior while changing interpretive coordinates
review_warning: Scaling choices should be recorded and interpreted in relation to original units

formal_role: Tests output sensitivity under small input or coefficient changes
computational_role: Connects numerical sensitivity to modeling uncertainty
review_warning: Outputs that shift dramatically under small perturbations should not be overinterpreted

formal_role: Defines how numerical limits uncertainty diagnostics and model assumptions are communicated
computational_role: Prevents computed output from being treated as stronger evidence than it is
review_warning: Numerical diagnostics should accompany consequential model results
